data.rationale:
Research shows:
1. Legacy 'query' has 21 hardcoded patterns (~300 lines of if/elif)
2. New 'expr' has proper architecture but function calls fail in CLI
3. Root cause: executor's execute() method doesn't handle top-level FunctionCalls
4. Solution: Fix executor first (6 changes), then migrate query patterns to expr functions

This approach:
- Maintains backwards compatibility during transition
- Leverages existing function implementations (15 registered functions)
- Results in single Query Builder execution path
- Eliminates ~300 lines of duplicated pattern matching code
data.title: Query Consolidation Strategy: Fix expr function calls, then migrate query patterns
